title: Signal engine: per-capture prospective predictions (DRAFT): every active model (champion + challengers, frozen specs) writes write-once probabilities for every eligible market of each new capture using its newest fit made at or before the capture start; receipt-timed log line; exit 75 when nothing is due
expected_value: the prospective prediction record the daily leaderboard and the promotion rule score
next_action: runs indefinitely; newest capture first; a prediction is valid for a target only if logged before that target's capture slot
notes: DRAFT (signal engine v1, docs/research_lab/signal_engine/DESIGN_V1.md section 9). Measured on the host 2026-10-20 23:26-23:45Z in a read-only dry run (/tmp/sigeng, engine root outside ~/arepo, deleted afterwards). 8 models x 47,461 rows in 31 s (LightGBM 13-16 s each, logistic 0.3 s), peak RSS 295 MB; 5.2 MB per capture (~62 MB/day). Depends on q0510 only for ordering (it never blocks: no features -> exit 75). Embargoed challengers still write predictions (their scores are withheld until the embargo date). depends_on is empty on purpose: the other engine jobs are repeat jobs that never reach 'done'; missing inputs make this job exit 75 or report 'insufficient'/'no_fit' instead.
